status: post-diagnostic governance rule for future primary-evidence use
scope: CPS worker-share occupation composition used as an industry standardization or independent-source robustness input

primary_stability_rule.decision: A primary-comparability industry is primary_stable only when the diagnostic is <= 0.10 in every required period; otherwise it is sensitivity_unstable.

evidence_tiers.primary_stable: Definitionally primary-comparable and passes the empirical leave-one-month-out stability rule in every required period.
evidence_tiers.sensitivity_unstable: Definitionally primary-comparable but fails the empirical leave-one-month-out stability rule in at least one required period. Retain and report; do not use as equal-weight primary evidence without additional uncertainty work.
evidence_tiers.limited: Source-universe comparability is limited under the OEWS industry crosswalk; retain only as a diagnostic.
evidence_tiers.excluded: Source-universe definitions are not sufficiently comparable for the primary OEWS-CPS summary.

noninferential_boundary: The 0.10 L1 threshold is a project robustness standard, not a BLS/Census significance threshold. L1=0.10 corresponds to total-variation distance 0.05. Kish weight-dispersion effective n and monthly perturbation diagnostics do not incorporate CPS clustering, stratification, or rotation-group covariance and are not design-based uncertainty estimates.
retrospective_disclosure: This v1 threshold was adopted after the Q2-2025/Q2-2026 reliability diagnostics exposed a highly unstable thin domain. It is therefore not described as preregistered for this checkpoint. Full unfiltered results remain preserved, and filtered summaries must be presented as a governance/sensitivity layer.
future_rule: Apply the versioned rule before interpreting future CPS composition vintages as primary evidence. Changes to the threshold or diagnostic require a new policy version and must not rewrite historical classifications.
